elements.label: Budget
elements.description: Money set aside for this, and whether it is approved.

parts.label: Budget amount or range
parts.question: What range have you set aside for this, per year?

parts.label: Budget approved
parts.question: Is that budget approved, or does it still need sign-off? By whom?

elements.label: Authority
elements.description: Who makes the decision, and whether they are involved.

parts.label: Decision maker named
parts.question: Who makes the final call on this?

parts.label: Decision maker involved
parts.question: How should we involve them before you decide?

elements.label: Need
elements.description: The problem in the customer's words, and its priority.

parts.label: Problem in their words
parts.question: What problem are you trying to solve, in your own words?

parts.label: Priority against other work
parts.question: Where does this sit against the other projects on your list?

elements.label: Timeline
elements.description: When they decide or go live, and what drives that date.

parts.label: Decision or go-live date
parts.question: When do you need this decided, and when live?
